title: docs(spec): the allowExport comment and permission docs say no built-in admin set grants export
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBPgPimeeEd4Cs2XAg5w5WtX)_

Fixes #26720

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no `skills/**` file says the built-in admin sets grant export (grep over `skills/**` hits only the two reference-index lines that list `permission.zod.ts`); the two docs pages that said it are corrected here.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:三处文字(`permission.zod.ts` 里 `allowExport` 的注释、「Permission sets」与「Permissions matrix」两个文档页)原说内置管理员权限集带导出权限,现改为实情:不带,并写明怎么授予。
- 为什么改:实际出厂默认 `admin_full_access` / `organization_admin` 都不含 `allowExport`,管理员看不到导出按钮、导出接口回 403 `EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED`,文档却说有,误导管理员和 AI 作者。
- 风险与回滚:纯文字,零行为变化,出厂权限集一行未动;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx`(用户最常读的一句)、`content/docs/permissions/permissions-matrix.mdx`、`packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts`(只改 JSDoc,`.describe()` 原本就对)。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n -E 'carry the grant explicitly|carry .allowExport: true. explicitly|therefore carry' -- packages/spec/src/security content/docs/permissions`,预期零命中(main 上是 3 处)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts`, the `allowExport` JSDoc: "The built-in admin sets carry the grant explicitly instead." is replaced by: the built-in admin sets (`admin_full_access`, `organization_admin`) do not carry it, an admin holding only those sets is refused export, and export is granted by binding the admin to an app or environment permission set that names each object with `allowRead: true, allowExport: true`. The `.describe()` string was already true (it never mentions the admin sets), so it is unchanged and no reference page regenerates.
- `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx`: "The built-in `admin_full_access` and `organization_admin` sets carry `allowExport: true` explicitly; remove that line to get the separation." becomes: no built-in set carries `allowExport` (admin, org admin, member), what the admin sees (no Export control, `403 EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED`), and how to grant it.
- `content/docs/permissions/permissions-matrix.mdx`: "The built-in `admin_full_access` / `organization_admin` sets therefore carry `allowExport: true` alongside their super-user bits." becomes the same correction.
- `.changeset/26720-admin-export-docs.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch (the JSDoc ships in the package's `src`).

The other JSDoc the order named (`objectPermissionGrants`, the conjunction note at ~:248) is true as written and is left alone.

## Why

What each built-in set actually grants for export, on `origin/main` 8074feb6:

- `admin_full_access`: spreads `ADMIN_FULL_ACCESS_CAPABILITIES` (`packages/spec/src/identity/eval-user.zod.ts:115`), whose `'*'` entry has read/create/edit/delete plus `viewAllRecords` / `modifyAllRecords` and no `allowExport` (removed by the 2026-08-15 maintainer ruling; the migration entry is `18.admin-export-wildcard-removed`).
- `organization_admin` (and the derived `organization_admin_no_bypass`): `'*'` with the same bits and no `allowExport` (`default-permission-sets.ts:391`).
- `member_default`: no wildcard, no `allowExport` (`default-permission-sets.ts:638`).
- `viewer_readonly`: `'*'` read only, no `allowExport`.

The gate that decides it: `resolveUserExportAllowed` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/permission-evaluator.ts:205`) is true only when some held set resolves `allowExport === true` for the object, and the REST export door (`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, `enforceExportPermission`) answers `403 EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED` otherwise. So the seeded admin's 403 is the shipped behaviour, and per triage the default stays. The corrected text now gives the reader the way in: an app or environment set with `allowExport: true` per object (a set carrying `allowExport` cannot be bound to the `everyone` / `guest` anchors, as the same page already says).

Not edited, on purpose: `18.admin-export-wildcard-removed.ts` quotes the old sentence as history of what upgraders were told, and the QA checklist JSON already describes the shipped behaviour.

None.
